(4) Comment: Place socio-economic data in Appendices
Response: Since much of the socio-economic date in Draft statement is meshed with other elements of the statement reorganization of the statement at this point is not practical; however, future statements can be written with this comment in mind.
b. Department of the Army, Baltimore Distric, Corps of Engineers
(1) <u>Comment</u>: Corps not involved in establishing flood areas in Harrisburg area.
Response: The original statement in the Draft EIS was erron bous. See corrected statement on page 49.
(2) Comment: Alternatives on page 81 are not true alternatives.
Response: See revised page 81.
c. United States Department of the Interior, Northeast Region
(1) <u>Comment</u>: Coordinate with Penn. Historical and Museum Commission and Section 106.
Response: See part II, paragraph 7.e and part V paragraph 4.b for evidence of coordination and statement to the nature of action as it relates to historical consideration.
(2) <u>Comment</u>: Steps being taken to minimize harm to historic archeological and aesthetic resources.
Response: See (1) above for historic. There are no known archeological sites within the project area. See part V, paragraph 4.c for discussion of aesthetics of the area.
(3) Comment: Impact on wildlife, its habitat, and trees and plants
Response: It is believed that the Draft EIS covered these points in sufficient detail.
(4) <u>Comment</u>: Relationship of existing open space plans and the needs of the community.
